description: Election Commission - S. Mahendran was Selected as the Member of the Colombo Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of the Colombo Municipal Council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for replacing a resigned council member, including the nomination by a political party and the official declaration by the Returning Officer. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and related administrative matters, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
